sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Three phases (breaks at 75%/50%/25%) built around a beam attack that gets progressively worse, plus a charge mechanic that punishes carelessness.

sections.heading: Fluxlance beams
bullets: Starts as single beams, becomes Fusillade (multiple sequential beams) at 75%, then Salvo (simultaneous beams) at 40% — the safe path through the beams gets narrower as the fight goes on.
Conduits struck by a beam gain charge — know where the conduits are so you're not accidentally feeding them.

sections.heading: Dancing Sparks & charge
bullets: Charged conduits release sparks that drift toward Decima — stand in a spark's aura to slow it down.

If sparks reach her, she gains charge stacks. At 10 stacks she goes invulnerable and unleashes an unsurvivable Flux Nova — preventing that buildup matters most in Challenge Mote, but it's still worth managing on Normal.

sections.heading: Breakbar
bullets: Defiance bar opens at 75% and 40% — breaking it applies Fractured Armor, making her vulnerable to a Flux Nova punish.
Ring-shaped ground AoEs (Earthrend, Seismic Crash) push you toward or away from Decima and the conduits — know which one is active before you reposition.
